title: Tensorized embedding domain Mirror views
hypothesis: In the amended learnable tied-embedding bigram task, one shared TT embedding with domain Mirror phase codes will match independent TT domain tables within 0.05 nat/token on two aligned domains while reducing actual inference bytes by >=15% versus the matched shared-TT/direct-coefficient control. The unrelated domain reveals whether private embedding state is needed.
physical_object: 16-token x 16-dimensional embedding matrix represented by order-4 TT cores with ranks 4 and tied as the output softmax matrix
mirror_coordinate: one domain phase on a selected shared TT core, with two shared core directions U/V
logical_multiplicity: three domain-conditioned bigram language models; two planted on one TT-core phase orbit and one unrelated

model.amendment_A3: Development-only diagnostic established that original scale 8 yielded near-uniform transitions even for independent full. A validation-only sweep on development seeds 32501/32502 selected teacher logit scale 32.0; architecture, data sizes, 600 updates, optimizer, LR, gates, and all fresh seed IDs remain unchanged. Selection used validation NLL only; no fresh/audit split accessed. Confirmatory development seeds will be rerun under A3 before fresh.

controls: hard-tied shared TT embedding with tied softmax head
independent TT embedding table per domain with tied head (PA34 native control)
shared TT cores plus two free direct coefficients per aligned domain on the selected core
shared TT cores plus one Mirror phase per aligned domain on that core
shared TT plus one private TT table for the unrelated domain as a shared/private upper control
independent full FP16 embedding table per domain with tied softmax head

storage.authority: actual deterministic fixed-timestamp ZIP/NPY inference payload bytes after reload
paid_objects: TT cores or full embedding tables
storage.head_tying: input embedding and output softmax share the same domain-specific effective table; count the table once and report this tied-head assumption

gates.promising: All 3 fresh seeds: each aligned-domain NLL is no more than 0.05 nat/token worse than independent TT; Mirror payload <=0.85x shared direct-coefficient payload; no worse unrelated-domain NLL than hard-tied; reloaded payload metrics exact.
gates.fail: Mirror misses the aligned NLL margin in >=2 seeds, or payload >=direct in >=2 seeds, or unrelated-domain error requires more private state than the frozen private-TT control.
gates.not_established: Independent-full development validation macro NLL >1.5 or aligned accuracy <0.50; payload reload/hash mismatch; train/test transition leakage; or changed settings after fresh access.
gates.development_gate: Both development seeds: independent-full validation macro NLL <=1.5 and macro accuracy >=0.50; each aligned Mirror validation NLL <= independent-TT validation NLL +0.05; actual Mirror payload <=0.85x shared direct-control payload. If any gate fails, keep fresh sealed.

boundaries: tiny synthetic bigram LM analogue, not nanoGPT or natural-language evidence
two domains deliberately share a planted TT-core orbit
fixed-update learning efficiency is not capacity
tied output head assumption is charged and explicit
A3 explicitly changes only teacher logit scale after development-only learnability sweep; fresh seeds remain sealed until A3 source/protocol and development gate are frozen.

amendments.disposition: corrected unrelated third-domain phase indexing before any fresh access; preserved as source history
two exploratory teacher rescalings failed to make original task learnable at frozen training budget; excluded

Selected logit scale 32.0 from development validation only after independent-full failure under scale 8; frozen before confirmatory A3 rerun and all fresh seeds. A3 confirmatory development passes learnability/quality but fails Mirror-vs-direct byte gate; fresh remains unopened.
